decisions.title: Source import retry fixture
decisions.statement: A byte-identical source decision import must retain one semantic graph across retries.
decisions.falsifier: The same project and source fixture create multiple imported authority graphs after a lost-response retry.
decisions.doesNotProve: This fixture does not prove source truth or safe historical duplicate repair.
decisions.noteText: Source import retry fixture. A byte-identical source decision import must retain one semantic graph across retries.
